1) three distinct motivational profiles for physical activities emerged from the cluster analysis: self determined, moderately motivated, and low motivated; 2) the clusters differed significantly from each other in terms of enjoyment of physical activity with self-determined and motivated clusters reporting high levels of enjoyment; and 3) the clusters also differed significantly from each others in terms of the relative strength of the three types of motivation: self determined, extrinsic, and amotivation.
